name: Vesalius College (Brussels School of Governance)
summary: English-taught college in Brussels, now the Brussels School of Governance: three BAs in international affairs, business and law, at €15,000 a year.

ib.text: IB Diploma with at least 27 points; no specific subjects required and no English test. Admission is selective: motivation essay, CV and transcripts, plus a €90 application fee.

dates.label: Application deadline for EEA citizens, autumn start (yearly date)
Applications for Fall 2027 BA programmes open

programmes.name: BA in Global Business and Entrepreneurship
BA in International and European Law

notes: Tuition is €7,500 a semester for EEA and non-EEA students alike; merit scholarships cut it by up to 50%, applied for by 1 March for autumn entry.
The deadline page gives 30 June for EEA citizens starting in autumn, without naming a year; you can also start in the spring semester in January.
The degree is awarded by Vesalius College; the Brussels School of Governance is its alliance with VUB's Institute for European Studies.
